question: For which year was Manna Dey honored with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**2007**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​Indian playback singer, music director, and musician** Manna Dey were well-known and renowned on a global scale.
 
• He received his classical voice training from **Ustad Aman Ali Khan.**
 
• He belonged to the** Bhendibazaar Gharana.**
 
• In **1971 and 2005**, the Indian government presented him with the **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan **awards, respectively.
 
• In 2007, he received the** Dadasaheb Phalke Award.**
